fixes.name: Loop Head Tracking
fixes.loader_pin_reason: v0.6.x is not compatible with Firewatch's Unity 2017 Mono runtime.
fixes.addon_note: Headtracking-only — pair with a stereo fix (Geo-11, wiz3D, Vireio) to get 3D + headtracking together. Mono-only use is not supported in Stereopticon; use Loop's own Lopari launcher for that case.
fixes.pros: Decoupled look and aim — head tracking moves the camera, mouse still controls aim. Built-in smoothing for network jitter from phone trackers.
fixes.cons: Headtracking only — does not produce 3D output on its own.
issues: Game must be launched once after loader install to initialize
fixes.notes: Reads OpenTrack-protocol UDP head pose on port 4242. Stereopticon's OpenTrack hub adapter handles emission. For mono-only headtracking, Loop's own Lopari launcher is a cleaner fit.
